name: RSI_MAonRSI_Filling Step EA
summary: This EA trades based on RSI values combined with a Moving Average applied to RSI, using a filling step approach for position accumulation. It enters trades when RSI crosses its MA on RSI, incrementally adding positions in steps as the signal strengthens.
summary_zh: 该EA基于RSI值及其上应用的移动平均线进行交易，采用填充阶梯方式逐步建仓。当RSI穿越其MA时入场，随着信号增强逐步阶梯式加仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于RSI指标及其移动平均线的交叉信号，属于动量类策略。入场条件为RSI上穿或下穿其自身MA时分别做多或做空，采用阶梯式加仓方式，信号越强仓位越重。出场条件依赖反向交叉信号或预设的止盈止损水平。仓位管理采用填充阶梯模式，随价格朝有利方向移动逐步加仓。资金管理通过可配置的手数参数控制每步加仓量，但缺乏严格的净值风险控制机制。整体策略逻辑清晰但加仓机制在极端行情下可能放大亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on crossover signals between RSI and its Moving Average, classifying it as a momentum-type strategy. Entry conditions trigger long positions when RSI crosses above its MA and short positions when crossing below, using a step-filling approach to incrementally add positions as the signal strengthens. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or preset take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing employs a filling step pattern, gradually increasing exposure as price moves favorably. Money management uses configurable lot size parameters to control incremental position sizes, though it lacks strict equity-based risk controls. Overall the strategy logic is clear but the step-accumulation mechanism may amplify losses during extreme market conditions.

parameters.name: MA_Period
parameters.description: 应用于RSI的移动平均线周期
parameters.description_en: Moving average period for trend direction

parameters.name: Step_Distance
parameters.description_en: Distance between scaling steps in points

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points per level

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points per level, 0 for none

pros: RSI与MA结合产生较为平滑的交易信号，减少频繁开仓
阶梯式加仓在趋势行情中能够有效扩大盈利
参数可配置性强，交易者可根据不同品种调整策略
逻辑结构清晰，易于理解和优化
pros_en: RSI combined with MA produces smoother trading signals, reducing frequent entries
Step-filling position accumulation can effectively amplify profits during trending markets
Highly configurable parameters allow traders to adjust the strategy for different instruments
Clear logical structure makes it easy to understand and optimize
cons: 阶梯加仓在震荡行情中可能连续亏损放大风险
缺乏整体仓位上限控制，极端行情下风险敞口可能过大
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线上重复开仓
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下滑点成本较高
cons_en: Step accumulation may lead to consecutive losses and amplified risk in ranging markets
Lack of overall position ceiling control may create excessive risk exposure in extreme conditions
No new bar check mechanism may cause duplicate entries on the same bar
Absence of spread filter increases slippage costs in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加整体持仓手数上限，防止过度加仓
添加新K线检查机制，避免同一K线重复信号
加入点差过滤和波动率过滤，优化入场质量
improvements_en: Add an overall position size ceiling to prevent excessive accumulation
Implement a new bar check mechanism to avoid duplicate signals on the same bar
Incorporate spread filter and volatility filter to improve entry quality

risk_points: 阶梯加仓机制在逆势行情中可能快速累积亏损
缺少新K线检查可能导致信号重复触发
未设置整体最大持仓限制
risk_points_en: Step accumulation mechanism may rapidly accumulate losses in adverse trends
Missing new bar check may cause signal duplication
No overall maximum position limit is set
